lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible posterior to the gill slits is a dense cluster of small circular pixel maxima transitioning into a more ordered grid of larger, high-intensity spots along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with horizontal ridges to form a grid, with primary circular spots located within the resulting rectangular cells.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature runs across the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with highlights on the upper edge and shadowing below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density population of small, high-luminance spots across its entire visible surface, distinct from the body's grid-based patterning.
